mapper.select:
select h.*, ifnull(i.report_qty, 0) as report_qty, ifnull(i.scrap_qty, 0) as scrap_qty from z000_pp_order_report_header h left join ( select report_id, sum(yield) as report_qty, sum(scrap) as scrap_qty from z000_pp_order_report_item group by report_id ) i on h.report_id = i.report_id
AND @S@ h.buss_doc_id = bussDocId @E@ AND @S@ h.buss_date = bussDate @E@ AND @S@ h.buss_status = bussStatus @E@ AND @S@ h.aufnr = aufnr @E@ AND @S@ h.cmpy = cmpy @E@ AND @S@ h.cstc = cstc @E@ AND @S@ h.create_time = createTime @E@
@OS orders @OE
ORDER BY h.create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO z000_pp_order_report_header (report_id, buss_doc_id, aufnr, confno, confcnt, budat, buss_date, buss_status, bstp, router_code, title, remark, cmpy, cstc, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{reportId}, #{bussDocId}, #{aufnr}, #{confno}, #{confcnt}, #{budat}, #{bussDate}, #{bussStatus}, #{bstp}, #{routerCode}, #{title}, #{remark}, #{cmpy}, #{cstc}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
